capabilities: Bind sliders and controls to block state
Step through diagrams with synchronized code highlights
disambiguation: Not a knowledge-base or note-organizing interface; it renders interactive components from Markdown code blocks.
extras: Includes a local browser preview, validation CLI, and Codex Skill sharing Protocol v1; bundled teaching notes are in Chinese; only Linux with Chromium and Obsidian 1.15.1 has been tested.
problem: Obsidian notes are mostly static, so explaining a model or diagram requires external tools or static images.

relations.evidence: ask it to use $knowledge-ui to write a note with an interactive chart and validate the Markdown

summary: Markdown code-block renderer for interactive charts, diagrams, and controls inside Obsidian notes.
